tei:div.tei:p: (a)༄// mallikāyāmālanāmasarb+bamahādzñāḥsūryabandhorabadānambidzahāraṃ//

༄// thams cad mkhyen pa chen po nyi ma'i gnyen gyi rtogs pa brjod pa malli kā'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄// sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i bṛtta bcu gnyis pa skye 'gro la prāstā ra bzhi stong go drug mchis par yang ba'i bya ba gcig yang ba bcu gnyis rjes 'brang bcas pa/ yi ge bzhi khri rjes 'brang bcas/ lci yang so so nyi khri rjes 'brang bcas/ a dhwa 'phred nyer gsum/ steng 'og brgyad stong rjes 'brang du bcas pa yod pa'i nang gsel naṣṭa re ba bzhi pa uddiṣṭa chig stong dang chig brgya don gcig pas rtog phreng can zhes bya bas nye bar mdzes pa'o// ༄// tsakrakāyashtsaturthātmamawarm+matraṇāpāradāran+yashasta3pitīkṣ+ṇo3dhar shshāraṇaṃsebashāntaṃbhayābhyobhabaunishtsayastāyiratnatribhispālaya// ༄// rnam khyad par brjod pa las drangs pa'i shis par brjod pa/ bzhi'i dpung tshogs rang skyob ya lad dang*// pha rol 'dzoms pa'i rno mtshon 'chang min yang*// skyabs su bsten tsam srid zhi'i 'jigs pa las// nges par skyob pa dkon mchog gsum gyis skyongs// dge legs sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan stong phrag 'dzum du dmul mtshan bskal pa bzang po'i dbyig 'dzin mar// gzhan don khur khyer dam bca'i sa bon kun las ches bdo dus 'dir 'tshang rgya'i dpag bsam du// smon pa'i lam du tshogs gnyis rab song srid gsum snying po sngon med snye ma g.yur za bas// 'gro khams 'tsham par ci 'dod phrin las lag rtser sbyin pa nyi ma'i gnyen gyis shis pa stsol// thams cad mkhyen pa'i rtogs brjod phung po thun mong gdul bya'i blo gros rjes su legs shar ba// ji snyed bgrang ba'i 'jal byed dpal ni bdag la yongs su rdzogs snyam rgyu skar bu mo dag 'bras ldan mkha' la 'od bkrag rab 'byin rgyags pa'i yang rtser 'dzegs pa mi 'tshal phyogs bcu yi// sangs rgyas zhing gi rdul snyed grangs kyang khyod kyi bla mar 'phags pa'i 'gran zlar byed kyi dogs// de lta mod kyi dri med lung gis legs par 'doms pa'i mdzad pa malli kā yi phreng*// rang bzhin gyis brjod snyan dngags dam pa'i skud pa la brgyus blo gros mchog dman yongs kyi mgul// nye bar spud pa'i chun 'phyang 'di ko mdzes byed phal las dam pa'i snying pos khyad par che// bdag cag ston pa nyi ma'i gnyen gyur des// bde gshegs shākya thub chen spyan sngar sngon// byang chub thugs bskyed spyod pa'i chu gter gyi// pha rol son pa'i ngo mtshar mtha' klas mod// dzambhu'i rgyal mtshan gyis spud gling 'di na// 'gro 'dul mdzad pa ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul//

(1) dga' ldan gnas su dam pa tog gyur nas// theg chen chos kyi sgo 'phar legs phye bas// lha rnams smin byas ma pham rgyal tshab bzhag /'dzam gling 'gro ba smin phyir yul gzigs pa'i// rigs mtho rgyal po'i rigs su skye ba'i yul// 'dzam gling lto bar dus skabs skyes bu'i tshe// 'phel 'grib mtha' gnyis 'gong ba lo brgya par// mes brgyud skyon bral spyod ldan bud med ni// yon tan sum cu nyis ldan zla ba bcur// 'dzin pa'i las bzang lnga la rnam gzigs nas// skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i sems dpa' dang*// 'dod gzugs lha yis bskor gyin bskyod brtsams so// 'pho bar brtsams pa'i mdzad pa ste dang po'o// //nyi ma'i rgyud 'khrungs zas gtsang sras kyi phyir// sa ga'i zla nyar nam gyi gung thun la// gnyis las 'thung mchog gzugs kyis sgyu 'phrul ma// gso sbyong dge bas dag byas lhums su zhugs// (2) rin chen char bab long bas mig thob sogs// ngo mtshar ltas bcas yum gyi dku g.yas su// byis pa zla drug son pa'i na tshod kyis// khang bzang seng ge'i khrir bzhugs tshangs dbang sogs// nyin bzhin chos kyis smin byas zas gtsang dgyes// sbyin pa'i phyag brkyang 'jig rten rgud pa bcil// lhums su zhugs pa'i mdzad ste gnyis pa'o// // (3) zla ba bcu rdzogs yab yum 'khor tshogs bcas// lumbi'i tshal bzhud padma ltar bltams tshe// tshangs dbang dag gis bzung bar ma bzod par// nor 'dzin bu mos sprul pa'i padmar bzhugs// gang tshe shākya bram ze'i bu mo bu// srog chags ljon pa dga' tshal grangs med skyes// lha rnams kyis mchod klu rgyal sku khrus gsol// phyogs bcur gom pa bdun bor padma skyes// zas gtsang gis bsngags don kun grub mtshan gsol// zhag bdun tshal der bzhugs par lha mis mchod// sgyu 'phrul mtho ris gshegs nas ser skyar byon// skye dgu'i bdag mo sogs kyis rim gror bgyis// ser skya'i gzhir zhugs 'jigs med shāka thub grags// gnyug mar gnas pa lha yi khang pa ru// 'jig rten lhas btud lha yi lha zhes grags// drang srong mtshan btags 'tshang rgya 'gyur lung bstan// 'bras chen snod bzung glang po stong gis kyang*// dbrog par ma nus glang po stong thub grags// sku bltams pa'i mdzad pa ste gsum pa'o//

//mtshan bzang rgyan gyis bcos ma'i rgyan bsgribs tshe// skyed (4) tshal lhas bstod yab kyis bskul bzhin du// srin bu'i go cha bzang len lhar bcas las// yi ge rtsis sogs bslab pa'i tshul bstan tshe// 'gran zla kun bral gzhon nu'i tshogs smin mdzad// zhing pa'i grong bzhud dzambū'i grib ma yis// sku lus ma btang gang tshe mngon shes ldan// drang srong mkha' la 'phur ba'ang thogs gyur tshe// lha dang drang srong zas gtsang bsngags pa phul// 'jig rten mthun bzhed btsun mo'i mtshan nyid rnams// lag na be con bu mo la mthong ba// da dung brtag phyir gzhon nu ma yi tshogs// sbyin pa'i rwa bar bsdus tshe sa 'tsho mar// gzhon nu dgyes par rig nas bslang ba na// sgyu rtsal gang la mkhas der sbyin par bcas// bu mo grags 'dzin rgyal ba'i ru mtshon bzhag /gcung mdzes dga' bo legs skar ming chen dang*// lhas byin la sogs shākya lnga brgya dang*// tshan po che yi stobs ldan lnga brgyar lhags// thog mar lhas byin phrag dog glang chen bkums// gcung mdzes dga' bos ro de gom bdun bor// gzhon nu shing rtar 'khod pa'i rkang mtheb kyis// rwa ba 'obs bdun brgal ba rgyang grags kyi// phyi rol bor ba'i sa la gshong du byung*// de bzhin yig rtsis mchongs rkyal sngon med bstan// gcod pa thogs med mi 'gyel 'dod na 'gyel// stobs kyi khyad par dga' bo mdzes dga' yis// drung du lhag pa phyag gis reg 'phral 'gyel// shākya lnga brgya bsgyel ba'i nga rgyal can// lhas byin byung ba phyag g.yas mkha' la 'phyar// mgal me ltar bskor sa la gan rkyal brdab// shākya lnga brgyas rub kyang dus gcig bsgyel// 'phong rtsal 'bem du lcags shing tā la bdun// gzhan pas gcig gnyis gsum bcad gzhon nu yis// thams cad bcad mthar sa las chu mig rdol// rgyang tshabs dpag tshad gnyis nas bcu yi bar// tā la bdun dang lcags rnga phag pa btsugs// gzhan dag nye ba'i 'bem las thal nus min// gzhon nus mes kyi gzhu bdungs lcags mda' sbyar// gzhan dang rang gi 'bem kun phug pa'i mthar// khor yug ri bor thal bas khron pa rdol// gzhan yang sgyu rtsal kun la 'gran bral gyur// sgyu rtsal bstan pa'i mdzad pa ste bzhi pa'o//

//de nas shākya lag na be con gyis// (5) ngo mtshar de mthong phul ba'i sa 'tsho sogs// btsun mo'i 'khor rtsen gang tshe lhas byin mdas// bsnun pa'i ngang pa bsos nas gshegs lam du// sbrul gdug mdun du rgyug pa 'char kas bkrongs// 'bab chu ro hi ta yi 'gram ngogs shing*// dge ba'i snying po 'gyel bas gnod byas kyang*// mang pos ma thegs ci bya gtol med par// phyag blangs nam mkha'i dbyings 'phangs dum bur gtubs// lam du sbed ma ri dwags skyes gnyis la// dges pa'i tshul bstan gzhon nu'i btsun mor blangs// brgyad khri bzhi stong btsun mo'i 'khor rtsen tshe// mngon par 'byung phyir phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yis// sil snyan sgra dang bsres pa'i glu yis bskul// btsun mo'i 'khor gyi rol pa ste lnga pa'o// // (6) skyo ba bstan slad skyed mo'i tshal bzhud tshe// grong khyer sgo bzhir lha rnams kyis sprul pa'i// rga na 'chi gzigs bdag kyang 'di 'dra gsung*// dge slong mthong bas rab tu 'byung blo skyes// sna tshogs thabs kyi 'gegs pas ma bzlog par// yab la gnang ba mnos nas sgra gcan 'dzin// sras su byin brlabs rta mchog bsngags ldan bcibs// brgya byin tshangs pa 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha// dpag med kyis bteg lha yi sil snyan dang*// rol mo'i sgrar bcas nam phyed mngon par 'byung*// (7) shākya'i yul nas spong byed yul gyi bar// dpag tshad bcu gnyis 'das pa chu klung 'gram// rgyan bkrol bsngags ldan 'dun pa rang yul bzlog /de tshe shākya'i yul gyi skye 'gro kun// mya ngan gyis non mchi ma'i char rgyun bsnyil// rgyal kun dbyings nas dgyes pa'i legs so stsal// mngon par 'byung ba'i mdzad pa ste drug pa'o// //gzhon nu rang gi cha lugs bsgyur ba'i ched// utpal 'dab 'dra'i mtshon gyis gtsug phud bregs// brgya byin gyis blangs lha yul dus ston byung*// 'chi med dbang po rngon pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// shing gi lha las sha na'i gos blangs te// ka shi'i gos dang brjes pa sku la gsol// ngan spong bu yis me tog 'bras bus bstabs// gzugs can snying pos rgyal srid phyed bstabs kyang*// bzhugs par ma gnang ring 'phur lhag spyod kyis// nyer bstan ting 'dzin bsgoms pas ma tshim par// lnga sdes rjes 'brangs ga ya'i ri rtser bzhugs// lteng rgyas phyogs kyi nai rañdza na'i 'gram// mkha' khyab ting 'dzin lo drug snyoms zhugs nas// dbugs rgyu 'gags pa shi ba'i gtam thos nas// sgyu 'phrul lha mos lhag pa dbugs dbyung stsal// ting 'dzin de las bde gshegs kyis bskul bzhengs// dur khrod mnal sogs dman pa'i 'gro don mdzad// ye shes sku lus 'og min 'tshang rgya bstan// ri rab rtse mor rnal 'byor rgyud sde stsal// slar yang rnam par smin pa'i lus su zhugs// dka' ba spyad pa'i mdzad pa ste bdun pa'o//

// (8) gdung bas byang chub 'thob dka' bstan pa'i phyir// rags pa'i ras dang phyag dar khrod bzhes phyir// dur khrod ro las sha na'i ras blangs pa// chu la bkrus gsol gad par 'dzegs pa'i tshe// shing gi lha mos yal ga brkyang bsu ste// spyod yul grong gshegs dga' mo dga' stobs kyis// ba stong 'o ma'i nying khu sbrang rtsir bcas// phul bzhes mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku mdangs gsal// gser snod rgya mtshor bor ba lha yul khyer// sa gzhan dag gis ma thegs 'tshang rgya'i gnas// byang chub snying po lha rnams kyis brgyan par// der gshegs bkra shis las blangs rtswa gdan steng*// zag zad yang dag ma thob de srid du// mi ldang dam bca'i rdo rje skyil krung bcas// shar du zhal gzigs dran pa mngon bzhag nas// sku las 'od bkye phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i sras// grangs med bskul bas mdun bdar bkod pa bstan// zhing kun rgyal bas phyag brkyang rgyal 'gyur gsol// byang chub kyi snying por gshegs pa'i mdzad pa ste brgyad pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i smin mtshams mdzod spu las// yid (9) srubs bskul ba'i 'od bkye bdud sde yi// dmag tshogs mi sdug rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed kyis// sna tshogs mtshon char phab pa me tog gyur// bdud kyi bu mo'i 'phyon 'drid du mas kyang*// ba spu'i rtse mo ma bskyod kun gyi blar// 'phags pa'i dpang gsol phyag g.yas sar bsnun pas// bstan mas lus phyed phyung nas mngon par bsngags// gshin rje'i gshed sogs sprul te rgyud sde gsungs// bdud dpung pham zhing sems myos zla med pa'i// stobs dang seng ge rnam par rtse mthong nas// srog chags grangs med byang chub sems bskyed do// bdud btul ba'i mdzad pa ste dgu pa'o// //bdud las rnam par rgyal nas byang chub phyogs// mthun par bsgoms pa'i rnal 'byor rjes zhugs te// (10) nam gyi cha stod rdzu 'phrul lha'i rna ba// nam gung mngon par shes bskyed skya rengs shar// bla med byang chub bdud rtsi brnyes tshul bstan// gang tshe phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas phyag brkyangs te// snyun gsol rgyal ba'i sras spros mchod pas mchod// tā la bdun srid mkhar 'phags ched brjod tshe// gtsang ris bcas pa'i lhas mchod sa yi phyogs// nor bu me tog rgyan bkod byin brlabs nas// rnam snang gang chen mtshor bzhengs phyag gi mthil// zhing khams rgya mtsho'i sprin bkod bstan pa'i tshe// kun bzang 'jam dpal la sogs phyogs bcu nas// lhags pa'i rgyal sras rnams la phal chen sogs// chos bstan nor bu'i char phab cho 'phrul bstan// gshegs nas rdo rje rgyal mtshan bsngo ba sogs// cho 'phrul bsam yas dag pa'i 'khor la shar// spyi mthun me khams zhag bdun snyoms par zhugs// gzhan 'phrul gnas su phyag rdor dbang bskur dang*// rnam snang mngon byang sogs bstan spyi mthun ngor// bdun phrag gnyis par stong gsum rgyang ring 'chag

/gsum par byang chub snying por spyan ras gzigs// bzhi par shar nub rgya mtshor mi ring 'chag /lnga par btang bzung gnas su btang bzung sogs// gdengs can sku la 'khril bas yul ngan bsrungs// stobs chen gzungs stsal bdud btul skyabs su bkod// drug par n+ya gro dha skyong shing drung bzhugs// rten cing 'brel 'byung lugs 'byung lugs bzlog gzigs// bdun par sgrol rgyur ga gon bzang po'i bshos// rgyal chen bzhis phul rdo ba'i snod du bzhes// shis pa brjod nas sbrang rtsi 'byung lung bstan// bser ma'i snyun thebs brgya byin sman mchog phul// yid srubs mya ngan 'da' gsol ma gnang la// chos 'khor bskor ba mi bzhed ngal gsor bzhugs// mngon par byang chub pa'i mdzad pa ste bcu pa'o// //gang tshe tshangs pa gtsug phud can gyis sngon// smon lam rjes dran shing rta la brten nas// lan gsum gsol btab tha mar rjes su gnang*// nyer 'gros mar la klu rgyal blta mdzes dang*// khyim bdag bshos gsol gaṅgā'i steng gshegs nas// lnga sde mdun bsu stan bstabs phan par gdams// wā rā ṇa sī'i drang srong lhung grags par// tshangs dbang gis mtshon lhas sprul seng ge'i khrir// skyil krung legs bcas spros pa'i 'od zer gyis// bskul ba'i 'phral la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i sras// 'jig rten sde brgyad 'dus pas stong chen khyab// gang tshe rgyal sras tshangs pa brgya byin gyis// rtsibs stong 'khor lo phul nas gsol btab ngor// bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor khebs pa'i ljags brkyangs te// bden bzhi'i chos 'khor lan gsum bzlas bskor bas// dgra bcom bden mthong chos mig dri med kyis// 'jig rten sngon med mdzes pa'i rgyan du byin// shugs 'chang rgyal ba'i gtsug tor mtha' gzhal slad// zhing mang brgal yang ma gtogs ched du bsngags// ston par dad pa'i khyim bdag dge bzang gis// thog ma'i gtsug lag khang brtsigs lnga sder phul// rigs gtsor chos bstan bden mthong bu lnga dag

/rab byung dgra bcom nye ba'i lnga sder grags// de thos grong mi'i khye'u drag po sogs// lnga bcu dag kyang rab byung dgra bcom gyur// rgyal gsung tshigs bcad rnam thos bus bzung don// e la'i 'dab kyis kun la dris pa'i don// ston pas legs gsungs mes byin 'khor du bcas// rab byung e la'i 'dab kyi sngon byung stsal// sde can 'char ka la sogs bzang po'i tshogs// rab byung bram ze lha yi bshos gsol nas// legs skyes ma sogs dad byas bden mthong bkod// skye bo'i tshogs rab gdul phyir lteng rgyas kyi// 'od srungs sna tshogs thabs kyis dbang byas nas// de dang chu klung ga ya 'od srungs gsum// stong phrag 'khor bcas rab byung dgra bcom bkod// dge slong stong bcas ga ya mgo rir gshegs// byang sems lha dang drang srong sgron me sogs// 'khor tshogs dbus su ga ya mgo ri'i mdo// don rnams rgyal ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs bstan// gzugs can snying pos spyan drangs ma ga dhā'i// rab brtan smyug ma'i tshal byon rgyal pos mjal// 'od srungs rdzu 'phrul chen pos zhabs btud de// ston pas mdo stsal 'khor bcas bden pa mthong*// dad pas 'od ma'i tshal phul de nas brtsams// ston pa 'khor bcas bsnyen bkur rgya cher bstabs// zla gsum gang pos bshos gsol lung bstan brnyes// sā la'i phug tu me khams snyoms zhugs tshe// dri za'i glus bskul bar chod skyong gzungs kyis// brgya byin shi 'phos 'phral la skye bar mdzod// rta thul mthong dad nye rgyal pang nas skyes// lnga brgya'i 'khor bcas rab byung mchog zung gyur// sdig can tho btsams ma nus bu smad tshogs// chos bstan bu mo phor gyur bzod pa thob// chos gos bya rgod khyer lhung rdor gyur pa'i// bya rgod spungs rir sen rings zhus mdo stsal// de dang 'od srungs bsnyen rdzogs snam sbyar phul// lta sdug 'khor ba dbyig gi mtsho rab byung*// shin tu bzang gi chung mar bu 'byung bar// ston pas lung bstan ma bzod bsad pa'i ro// dur khrod bskyur ba bsregs pa'i lto ba nas// padma'i snying por khye'u me skyes byung*// zas byin rgyal byed tshal brtsigs mig dmar gyis// phrag dog shing dang pad mtsho sbrul ro longs// sprul pa nye rgyal rdzu 'phrul gyis bcom ste// khang chen mang brtsigs bcom ldan spyan drangs phul// gzhon nu'i mdo gsungs gsal rgyal dad par byas// rlung nag gis 'jigs tshong pa lnga brgya sogs// rdzu 'phrul phyag ring brkyangs te drangs rnams dang*// drang srong zas gtsang pho nya tshogs rab byung*// 'char kas dad par byas te zas gtsang gis// n+ya gro dha yi gtsug lag khang brtsegs nas// ston pa spyan drangs lha yi 'khor dang bcas// yab sras mjal te chos bstan mang po grol// bdud rtsi zas kyis sbas kyang kun dga' bo// ston pa'i mthus byung rjes 'brang rab tu byung*// gcung dga' rab byung chung mar chags pa'i skyon// lha dang dmyal ba bstan pa'i thabs kyis btul// btsun mo'i nang du gdugs tshod gsol gshegs tshe// grags 'dzin sras kyis la du 'bul btang bas// ston pas sku mang sprul yang sprul gzhir phul// grags 'dzin lcebs pa ston pa'i mthu yis bzung*// lha yi khang bzang sde brgyad 'khor 'dus tshe// zas gtsang mthong phyir khang bzang shel sbrul nas// 'dod gzugs lhas mchod yab sras mjal mdo gsungs// 'khor tshogs shākya mang po lung bstan stsal// shākya lnga brgya rang byung chung ma rnams// chos bstan gang tshe bran mo skyed mas kyang*// tshigs bcad thos nas song ba ba lang gis// brdungs nas shi 'phos mu tig 'khri shing skyes// rab 'byor skul byed dag kyang rab byung stsal// ston pa 'khor sgyur tshul gyis ka pi na// dregs pa btul nas 'khor bcas dgra bcom bkod// dmus long 'phye bo rnal gnas rab tu byung*// tshem bu 'phye bo chom rkun gsod brtsam tshe// sangs rgyas gsol btab gnod sbyin gzugs kyis byon// dam pa'i chos bstan thams cad rab tu byung*// 'dod chung bsngags pa brjod cing shākya rnams// rnyed pa bor nas chos bstan bden par mthong*// skye dgu'i bdag mo la sogs nan tan gyis// gsol btab lce chos khas blangs rab tu byung*// dmus long skyes pa mi sdug sngon las bstan// spre'u rdzing 'gram seng ge'i gtsug lag khang*// bzhugs nas chos bstan bden mthong dad par mdzad// phyi sa khung pa yi dwags khrod 'khyam pa// chu sbyin stsal ba'i yi dwags lhar skyes pas// cig shos dad pas rab byung dgra bcom thob// 'phong gis dregs pa'i yangs can gzhon nu rnams// 'phong skyen tshul gyis btul nas bsnyen par rdzogs// snying rje bzang po gsod sar khrid pa'i tshe// ston par skyabs gsol 'jigs med stsal de dang*// bsngags ldan bram zer skyes dag dgra bcom stsal// sbrang rtsis bstabs pa'i spre'u chur lhung ba// shi 'phos bram ze'i khye'ur skye bar mdzad// drang srong lhung bar rgyal sras dgra bcom dbus// padma dpal gyi snying pos zhus pa'i ngor// sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mdo gsungs// sring mo rdul bral sems bskyed skyes par gyur// bat+sa'i rgyal po 'char byed dmag bshams pa// nyon mongs dgra ngo sprad de dad par byas// rgyal po yul 'khor skyong ba bsnyen par rdzogs// rgyal khab tshong pa lnga brgya ser sna'i rgyus// yi dwags skyes pa'i 'phrin bzhin bshos gsol nas// yon rabs gsungs pas lhar skyes bden pa mthong*// gser la chags pa'i khyim bdag sbrul skyes pa// khro ba zhi byas shi 'phos lhar skyes shing*// dge 'dun dang bcas bshos gsol sdig sbyangs mdzad// dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor dag pa'i chos bstan tshe// pang skyes 'od zer rgyal po'i zhing gi bar// phyin te gsung gi dkyil 'khor mtha' gzhal yang*// ma rtogs 'ong ba'i lam ston ston pa la// gsol btab skad cig rang gnas sleb cing bstod// ba shi tse dang chu smad utpal mdog

/dngos dang brgyud kyis rab byung dgra bcom gyur// lha dbang khang bzang phul nas chos nyan par// legs skar gnod sbyin gzugs 'dras ston par bsdigs// ko sa la ru phyugs skyong ma he'i khyu// bskyangs pa'i khrod nas gcig cig ston pa'i zhabs// lces bldags shi 'phos lhar skyes bden mthong rgyus// rdzi bo lnga brgya rngon pa'i tshogs rab byung*// mnyan yod phyi sa'i srin bu dge slong mgo /mi bzad sdug bsngal bstan nas sngon rabs gsungs// ne tsos sgo khyi'i sngon rabs gsungs khros pa// bden mtha' sbas pa'i nor skal bstan pas shes// dad pas bshos bstabs gsal rgyal ngang pa'i tshogs// pham babs stsal bas lhar skyes dam chos bstan// phyi sa khung gi yi dwags lhar skyes pas// bskul te grogs sgo wa can dgra bcom thob// bu mo skem mo 'od bzang zla ba dang*// mi sdug ma rnams rab byung dgra bcom stsal// dgra bcom mang bkums rgyal po sgam po la// dmyal bar skyes pa chu klung 'gram bkug ste// sngon byung gsungs pas 'gro mang chos la bkod// srid pa'i thog dang gzhon nus pha ma bsad// dge slong khrod du rab byung ston pa'i bkas// spyugs mthar dmyal bar lhung ba shi 'phos nas// rgyal chen ris skyes chos bstan bden mthong mdzad// glu mkhan rab dga' khye'u mi sdug pa// rang rang gzugs kyis btul nas rab byung stsal// khyim bdag gdangs can drang srong lnga brgya bcas// rab byung gdangs can kun ra brtsigs nas phul// rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis nam mkha'i lam nas gshegs// rgyal byed tshal du bcu gnyis sde rab byung*// gang po dad pas rab byung dgra bcom nas// phu bo rgya mtshor zhugs pa rlung chen gces// gsol btab skad cig der byon 'jigs las bskyabs// tshong pas tsandan sa mchog khang brtsigs nas// sangs rgyas spyan drangs lam du bud med dang*// drang srong chos bstan gshegs mthong ba ku la// warga'i yul gyi mi sdug pa rab byung*// gtun ri las mchongs bsnyen rdzogs rjes su 'brangs// khang bzangs lha mis mchod byas gser gzungs stsal// chu gter klong gshegs gdangs can chos skal gsungs// mis byin rtags stsal ma gros mtsho 'gram gshegs// klu rnams smin byas ye shes rgyas mdo stsal// maung gal bu yis rnam brtags rang gi pha// tshangs pa'i lhar skyes maung gal mnar mes ltung*// phrad phyir ston pa'i yo byad thogs te song*// ma yi sdug bsngal gyis skrag ston pa'i mchog

/spyan drangs byon pas 'gro mang dmyal las bton// maung gal yi dwags gnas spar de nas kyang*// shi 'phos khyi mor skyes don mdo bklags pas// 'od zer can zhing bzang mo gzhon nur skyes// rdzu 'phrul gyis gshegs ma bu phrad dga' stsal// chos sbyin bu mo khyim thab kyis 'thams pa// utpal mdog btang 'phrin gyis bsnyen rdzogs stsal// shā ri'i bu sogs pha rol phyin bzhi gsungs// klu chen dbyig bzang bye ma'i char gyis gtses// dad pas bslab pa'i gzhi blangs ston pa la// zla gsum bsnyen bkur rang sangs rgyas lung bstan// dge slong rnams la dran pa nyer gzhag dang*// nye rgyal gang bor bsam gtan phar phyin gsungs// ka tyā yān bu mtha' 'khob 'dul btang nas// skra can bu mos bshos bstabs rab snang gis// dad pas rgyal srid phul ba ston par zhus// gtsug lag khang brtsigs dge 'dun 'bul bar bskul// bya rgod spungs par rgyal sras dge 'dun tshogs// bde gshegs snying po dad pa bsgom mdo gsungs// sangs rgyas skyabs su song ba'i bram ze pha// lha ru skyes nas 'ongs pas bden pa mthong*// de yi bu dang gzhon nu dan bi li// dga' mo dga' stobs bcas pa rab byung stsal// rgyal byed tshal du brgya byin gyis sprul pa'i// khang bzangs yongs 'du'i drung gi khrir bzhugs nas// dbul po des pa byang chub lung du bstan// rab tu byung nas de yis zhus pa gsungs// dpas byin la sogs khyim bdag lnga brgya dag /byang chub lung bstan de yis zhus mdo gsungs// sa gas gdugs tshod spyan drangs bden mthong tshe// gsal rgyal khrims phog khye'u so gnyis mgo /ma la bstan pas 'dus byas mi rtag rtogs// las bzang gser dbyig rab byung dgra bcom brnyes// tha gas ras zung phul ba mchog lung bstan// skal ldan lha yi me tog grags pa'i bshes// lag par gser 'jo bā ra dhwa dza dang*// gser mdog gser gyi 'od can khyo shug dang*// gser gyi glang chen lhan skyes gser glang can// chung ma chos gos can rnams rab byung stsal// tshe dpag med mdo spobs pa'i blos zhus stsal// sdum par spyan drangs bshos gsol mu to gnyis// dga' dang khros pas rgyal srid dmyal bar thob// ri dwags kun rar sa gas spyan drangs tshe// 'jam dpal dris lan don rnam nges mdo gsungs// ne'u tsos spyan drangs gzugs snying zhal zas bstabs// dga' bzhin tshe 'phos lhar skyes bden mthong mdzad// bya rgod spungs par rgyal sras dge 'dun tshogs// me tog tshogs dang sangs rgyas dbu rgyan gsungs// bzang byin dgon pa par brten 'khrig chos dgag

/mi pham rgyan mnyes mdzes dga' rigs gnyis sogs// mang po rab byung dgra bcom sa la bkod// glang bu gnyis kyis 'thab pa rgyu lto dral// 'chi khar chos bstan thos pas mir skyes pa// de dang bde byed bcas pa rab tu byung*// yal ga'i grib bsil gyis g.yob glang po zhig /seng ges bsad 'phral lhar skyes bden pa mthong*// nor can la brten pham pa gnyis pa bcas// pi linda bu rab byung bro 'chel bas// ston pa nad g.yog la bsngags nad pa yi// bslab gzhir bcas nas rgyu rkyen rab tu byung*// rgyal byed tshal du dbyar gnas gsal rgyal gyis// dar ba'i btung ba brims sogs bsnyen bkur tshe// phyugs rdzi rnams dang lhag 'phags sbed ma'i bu// sgur po 'od srungs skyes sogs rab byung stsal// de tshe zas sbyin bu rnams mnyan yod kyi// chom rkun gyis brkus lhas sbren maung gal bus// 'phags skyes dpung du sprul te thar bar mdzad// ded dpon dga' byed byang chub lung bstan stsal// rgya mtsho 'khor bcas rlung chen gru bskyod tshe// ston par skyabs gsol gegs med 'byor rnams dang*// khye'u bdun rnams dad pas rab tu byung*// sangs rgyas rdzogs byed la dga'i tshong dpon gnyis// gang bzang brtsad pa'i zhal lce me tog 'di// mchog la 'bab pa gsol btab rgyal la 'bab// gnyis ka dad gyur byang chub lung bstan thob// pi linda pu rang gis gtsug lag khang*// ral 'drums 'chos pa mthong nas gzugs snying gis// zhabs 'bring lha 'bangs phul ba bzhes rung gnang*// tshong dpon dge bsnyen ched du ston pa yis// bzhugs nas brgya byin mthu yis dga' tshal sprul// rgya cher mchod pas byang chub de lung bstan// sgron shing tshal du dge sbyong sbed las brtsams// srog gcod pa yi pham pa gsum pa bcas// chu klung yid 'ong ldan 'gram nya pa yis// mi bzad mgo mang ldan pa'i chu srin drangs// nger byon sngon rabs gsung bas yid skyo nas// nya pa rab byung ser skya lhar skye mdzad// sha ba'i tshal du dbyar gnas nya pa rnams// dgra bcom khas blangs rdzun gyi pham pa bcas// sgra ngan grong rdal ste'u lta bu dang*// skyo ba'i tshul gsungs zas gtsang sku gdung mchod// bzang po rab byung dgra bcom pha ma yang*// de yi cho 'phrul gyis dad rab tu byung*// dmus long shākya bde bar mig sbyong gzungs// stsal ba de 'phral dri med mig thob gyur// bzhin gsal sogs la phyogs bcu mun sel dang*// sgra gcan 'dzin phyir me kha la gzungs stsal// ko sa la ru mnyam gzhag padma'i snying*// ma sdug bcas par chos bstan bden par bkod// seng lding nags pa rab byung dgra bcom brnyes// tshul 'chos pa la chos gsungs bden pa mthong*// bram ze'i bu mos bshos bstabs rang rgyal du// lung bstan de yi khyo yang bden mthong bkod// thod pa'i sgra las lung ston ri dwags mgo

/dgra bcom thod pas skyengs mthar bsnyen par rdzogs// rgyags pa zhi ba'i chos bstan dgra bcom thob// ri dwags 'dzin gyi kun rar tsampa mos// bsnyen bkur sbyin brgyad gtong ba khas blangs phul// dga' bo nye dga' khros pas ri rab dkris// de 'dul rgyal bas maung gal bu btang*// sprul pa'i klus mnan gti mug g.yur sad tshe// dgra bcom gzugs kyis lus kun thogs med rgyus// skrag pas skyabs gsol ston pas bdud rtsi stsal// klu de mi gzugs sprul lhags chos nyan tshe// gsal rgyal gyis bsdigs lan du mtshon char phab// de rgyu gsungs pas bzod gsol rnal gnas mdzad// bzang byin bus pa nyes med rgyal pos bkums// skyo bas bdog dgu sbyin gtong me 'od du// mdo bklags me khrims dral bas phyag sbal chud// slar btang ston pa'i drung song bsod nams mthus// rgyal po snyun gyis thebs 'phral bshags su bcug /bye tshan gyis gtses klu yis bram zer sprul// rab byung ston pas mkhyen nas bskrad kyang dad// gang tshe nye rgyal rab byung dge 'dun 'tsho// na zla'i tshogs kyis gsol btab rgya mtshor zhugs// klu yis mgron gnyer chos bstan grur bzhag kyang*// gcig pus 'phyan pa nyi tshe'i dmyal bas skyong*// drang srong chos bstan rang nyid dgra bcom thob// drang srong grogs bcas chos gos grwa la 'thams// nam mkhar drangs te bcom ldan rab byung mdzad// shā ri'i bu las rab byung ba lang bdag /bas mthar gnas gnang rab 'byor dgra bcom grub// nam gru rab byung som nyi can du grags// bzang skyong lnga brgya'i grogs bcas rab tu byung*// ji 'jigs kyis mchod byang chub lud du bstan// bu yis bshul lam gser gyi glegs bus g.yogs// kha ba'i ri las 'od srungs 'gugs btang nas// shā ri'i bur bcas byang sems sde snod gsungs// tshong dpon mes byin rol mo mkhas mang bcas// dad pas sems bskyed byang chub lung bstan stsal// bya rgod spungs rir byang sems dge 'dun dbus// sku las stong chen khyab pa'i 'od bkye zhing*// sangs rgyas zhing gi bkod pa dpag yas bcas// shes rab phar phyin zhus lan bgro tshul gsungs// de bzhin ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi mdo// mi ldog 'khor lo yul 'khor skyong zhus pa// mi 'khrugs bkod pa lhag bsam bstan pa gsungs// ri bo grog mkhar zhes pa'i klu chen gnyis// mi gzugs kyis gnas gzugs can snying po yis// bskrad pas then pa mu ge byung ste slar// rgyal por bzod par gsol bcug dpal 'phel mdzad// gzugs can phyag 'tshal ched du ston pa la// chos gos mi nor mtshan ma gdab zhus nas// ma ga dhar gshegs zhing gi rnong rgal ltar// dras te drub pa kun dgar bka' stsal to// 'tsho byed dpyad kyi drin byin ras chen zung*// ston par chos gos gsum gyi rgyu ru phul// ston par rbad pa'i rtsal chen ro langs bdun// kun dga' bo la reg pa'i 'phral la 'gyel// 'chi bar nye tshe mchog zung phyogs bteg par// ston pas ro langs bdun pa'i gzungs kyis bsos// rab rtsal rnam gnon gyis zhus mdo yang gsungs// rgyal po'i gcung gis mchod ston ston pa drug

/spyan drangs gral mthar sangs rgyas bzhugs gsol yang*// kun gyi gong mar byung zhing chu dang zas// brims pa kun kyang thog mar gyur pa'i rgyus// phrag dog rdzu 'phrul 'gran rlom spobs pa bskyed// gsal rgyal cho 'phrul 'gran gsol ston pas gnang*// mnyan yod 'dun khang so so'i khri brtsigs nas// ston pa drug 'khod rgyal rigs grangs med 'dus// bcom ldan 'khor bcas nam mkha'i mthongs nas byon// kun rar zhugs pa'i sgo gseb 'od byung nas// 'dun khang bsregs sbyangs mdzes par byin gyis brlabs// tshes gcig so shing las skyes ljon shing che// ma tog 'bras bu phun tshogs g.yur za sprul// tshes gnyis g.yas g.yon rin chen ri bo gnyis// mi dang byol song ci 'dod longs spyod sprul// tshes gsum zhal bsil chu las padma'i rdzing*// sna tshogs 'od 'bar mig gi dga' ston bskrun// tshes bzhir rin chen rdzing la yur ba brgyad// 'bab chu chos sgra lhang lhang sgrog par sprul// tshes lngar zhal sgo las byung 'od zer gyis// 'gro kun sdug bsngal dang bral bde la sbyar// tshes drug der 'khod phan tshun sems shes shing*// so so'i dge sdig las kyang rig par mdzad// tshes bdun 'khor tshogs thams cad 'khor los sgyur// rin chen bdun sogs dpal 'byor tshang bar sprul// tshes brgyad srin po lnga dang gsang bdag gis// ston pa drug bskrad 'khor rnams dgra bcom bkod// tshes dgu tshangs ris bar gyi 'jig rten khams// snyegs pa'i sku las 'od stong dkrigs par bstan// tshes bcur mtshan mchog 'bar ba sku yi 'od// srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du snang bar mdzad// bcu gcig gzugs sku mi snang 'od bkye zhing*// tshangs pa'i dbyangs las dam chos 'byung ba bstan// bcu gnyis byams par snyoms zhugs gser gyi 'od// spros pas 'gro rnams byams pa'i sems la bzhag /bcu gsum lte ba las byung 'od zung rtse// rgyal ba'i skus mtshan de 'dras 'jig rten bkang*// bcu bzhir shar bas gtor ba'i me tog tshogs// sangs rgyas skus mtshan shing rta mang po sprul// bco lngar kun kyang ro brgya'i zas la rol// dmyal khams bco brgyad snang byas bde 'gror bkod// rdor gcod drag shul can gyis zhus pa gsungs// khyim bdag lnga brgya byams pa spyod dag la// byang chub sems dpa'i 'dul bar rab byung bcug

/ded dpon zhus pa gsungs nas byang chub bstan// spyar ma'i khye'u ma yi bor ba'i sar// gshegs nas dam pa'i chos bgros mkhar 'phangs nas// 'od 'byin snang ba bsam mi khyab mdo stsal// maung gal bu yis bcu bdun sde rab byung*// nag po bsnyen rdzogs bcu bdun sde rab byung*// bram ze'i drung du ston pa drug phyogs kyi// bram zes gsod par ma nus me 'bar ba// ston pa'i bka' yis 'phral du zhi mdzad pas// de dag dad par chos bstan bden par bkod// ga ya mgo rir rgyal sras dgra bcom tshogs// sgrib pa sel ngor dkon mchog sprin mdo gsungs// sum cu rtsa gsum chos bzang lha'i 'dun sar// gtsug tor rtse nas gdugs dkar can gyi gzungs// dga' ba'i tshal du lha bu dri med phyir// ngan song sbyong stsal brgya byin dbang bskur bcug /dga' ldan skyes 'phral ched brjod mchod phyir lhags// ar mo nig steng 'khor tshogs sgyu 'phrul ma'i// don mdzad dbyig dang ldan pa'i gzungs stsal to// brgya byin lha min gyis bdas rgyal mtshan rtse'i// dpung rgyan gzungs dang rten 'brel snying po dang*// rnam rgyal mi g.yo ba yi rgyud rnams stsal// dga' ldan gnas su sgrol ma las sna tshogs// kun nas sgor 'jug gtsug tor dri med gzungs// gzhan 'phrul shes phyin mi g.yo rtul phod rgyus// 'og min dam tshig gsum bkod la sogs gsungs// slar yang sum cu rtsa gsum de'i le'u// rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul sogs rgya cher gsungs// de nas ston zla 'bring po'i nyer gnyis la// bi shwa karmas sprul pa'i them skas las// tshangs gzugs 'dod khams lhas bskor 'dzam gling babs// gsal ldan grong du rgyal po rnam bzhi'i 'khor// dri za pi wang brdung ba'i tshogs kyis bsu// rgyal po bzod par skyes pa'i mchod rten bstan// dge bzang gtsug lag khang du dpal ldan mas// tsandan phul mthar byang chub lung bstan stsal// sangs rgyas byon pa'i zhabs rjes legs skar gyis// phyags mas bsubs kyang ma subs mang po skyo// sde chen bsnyen bkur dge slong bro 'tshal bar// sde can ma yis brla sha bcad pas gsos// drin gzo'i ched du bsgrubs pas dgra bcom thob// khyo shug ston pas chos bstan rma yang bsos// me skyes ma yi dku mnyed shi pa'i tshal// gtsug lag khang brtsigs ston pa spyan drangs phul// dpal sbas gcer bu gang pos ngan bslabs ltar// sgo khang me mdag bkang ba srab mos bkab// dug can zas sbyar me skyes zas sbyin gyi// bu mo gnyis sbas thub dbang spyan drangs tshe// me mdag padma'i tshal gyur bde bar byon// dug can 'bo bar brtsams kyang brims su bcug

/skyon bral dad par gyur la chos rab bstan// gnod sbyin 'phrog ma lnga brgya'i bu dang bcas// gzhan gyi byis pa btsas dgu za ba der// gshegs nas chung shos dga' byed shul lus pa// lhung bzed kyis bkab ma rnyed ston par zhus// gzhan la mi 'tshe khas blangs bslab gzhi bzung*// dga' byed bstan pas rab dga' bka' bzhin bsgrubs// bya rgod spungs par 'od srungs le'u dang*// rin chen phung po bden gnyis bstan pa bshad// rgyal byed tshal du chos dbyings rang bzhin med// 'jam dpal rnam 'phrul rab rtsal zhus mdo bstan// bzang ldan rab byung skad snyan 'gro ba dang*// sor phreng stong phrag gcig gis ma ldongs mi// bsad par dge slong gzungs byon sdod cig smras// nga sdod khyod ni log pas bslus mi sdod// ces gsungs 'phral la sdig bshags rab tu byung*// lag pa can dang lag skam rab byung stsal// byang chub shing drung bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i gzungs// sgo bzang sher phyin zla ba'i snying po gsungs// grong dpon stong thub bsad pa gnod sbyin skyes// nyin bzhi ba lang drug ldan shing rta'i zas// mi re 'bul bcas res bab byis pa'i mas// ston par skyabs gsol 'brog gnas drung gshegs te// yi dwags gzugs sprul skrag byas rang bzhin skus// chos bstan gzhan srog mi 'tshe khas blangs bcug /nga yis dge slong gtor ma sbyin par bcas// byis pa thar bar byas stsal lag brgyud grags// rgyal ba'i smon lam gyes 'tsho lam che chung*// dang po 'khor bcas rab byung phyi ma yang*// kha ton mchil lham byi dor gyis sbyangs nas// dgra bcom bcu gnyis sde yi ston par bskos// zhag bdun char babs dge 'dun zas dman tshe// 'jam dpal bsod snyoms lhung bzed gang bslangs pas// ma lus tshim bstabs bdud kyis dge slong rnams// mi sdug gzugs bsgyur ston pas phyis 'byung bar// lung bstan gyis skyo mang po tshe dus byas// bu mo rab sdug rab byung dgra bcom gyur// kau shambī dang yangs can dge slong rnams// ring nas 'thabs pa mnyan yod bsdums par mdzad// rna ba bye ri rgya mtsho'i 'gram 'phyan tsho// las kyi 'bras bu myang rig 'phrin bskyal nas// ka tyā yān las rab byung ston pa'i dung*// mnyam 'khod zhu ba lnga yi lan yang stsal// bram ze pha yis ston pa mjal 'phral du// bu zhes 'khyud der chos bstan rab tu byung*// mkhas pa chom rkun tshogs bcas bden mthong mthar// dge 'dun bsnyen bkur rab byung dgra bcom gyur// rgyal khab gshegs pa'i nags khrod brgyags med par// rab sdug ma yi bsod nams mthu brjod pas// lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang bar gyur pas brims// 'tsho byed gdugs tshod mgron du ston pa'i bkas// lam pa 'bod bskul ma dad bzlog pa mdzad// nag po rab byung gnod sbyin bden pa mthong*// bya rgod spungs rir phyag rgyar 'jug mdo dang*// 'chi 'pho bstan pa sgo mtha' yas sogs gsungs// gyad nor rta thul rab byung ston pa'i bkas// gnas mal 'bogs pa'i mchog gyur 'dus pa yis// ka tyā yā na pha ma bcas rab byung*// gzugs snying sgra sgrogs rgyal po'i skyes len du// rgyal sku rten 'brel bcas pa bris bsrings tshe// dad pas bden mthong dge slong mthong 'dod pas// ka tyā yān sogs btang nas 'gro don byas// nag pa glang chen rten bu chung mas bslus// de na gshegs slar bsnyen rdzogs dgra bcom bkod// zas sbyin ched du bu mang rton pa gsungs// skye bo 'thab rtsod phal cher rab byung stsal// lho byang lnga len rgyal po g.yul 'gyed tshe// gnyis ka pham pas yid phyung dang po de// rab byung dgra bcom cig shos byang chub bstan// klu yi phyag rgyas pha bsad sdig 'gyod pas// rgyal srid btang nas rab byung sems kyang bskyed// rgyal bu yan lag bcad pa ma yis bteg

/ston pa'i drung slebs phyir skyes sems bskyed bcug /gsod sar khrid pa'i mi rgod lnga brgya dag /kun mkhyen bka' yis nyer btang dgra bcom gyur// ko sa la yi chom rkun mig phyung rnams// sman gyis bsal nas chos bstan byang sems bskyed// bde byed gsod pa las btang rab tu byung*// nyer 'tshe zhi phyir 'od zer can ma gsungs// mnyan yod mi rgod lnga brgya sprul pa'i mi'i// mda' yis bsnun pa bsal nas sems bskyed do// gsal rgyal bsnyen bkur gyis bstabs dbyar gnas mdzad// rgyun shes bu phul ma dad dmyal bar lhung*// tshong dpon bro 'tshal sangs rgyas skyabs su gsol// spos ngad ldang las dpal gyi dum bu'i sman// len du brgya byin btang nas 'tsho bar mdzad// spyan ras gzigs kyis bcu gcig zhal gzungs phul// 'gro lding gsang 'dzin rma bya chen mo stsal// ma 'gags pa yis btul ba'i chom rkun tshogs// dus ldan sna ma'i me tog dgon pa pa// rab sdug mu tig phreng sogs dgra bcom bkod// bde gshegs rjes 'brangs tshong pa chom rkun gyis// gtses pa gter gyi sbyin pas lan drug bslus// chom rkun dad pas rab byung gdugs tshod bstabs// 'khor bcas nags me'i 'jigs pa las kyang bskyabs// bsil ba tshal du de'i mdo be con gsungs// 'bar ba'i phug tu sde brgyad khros pa'i yams// phyag rdor gyis gsol rgyal ba can gzungs gsungs// sā la'i nags kyi sha za gdul phyir gshegs// rnam thos bus gtses me yis bskor te btul// dbang po'i mgo 'dul gshegs nas 'phong skyen blo// rmongs byas yid 'byung 'khor bcas rab tu byung*// ri dwags brtul zhugs bzung ba'i skye bo'i tshogs// sprul pa'i zlas drangs mtshang brtol rab tu byung*// gzhang 'brum can la de nyid zhi byed gsungs// pad dkar mdo gsungs ngan song stongs mdzad do// rgyal kun me tog skyes bskur snyun 'drir lhags// phyogs bzhi'i rgyal bas pho nyar bskur ba'i gzungs// ston pa la phul nyi ma'i snying po gsungs// bdud kyis nyams byas klu bsos byang chub btud// ri rab rtse mor lha yi them skas gshegs// sems dpa' dgra bcom lha klu'i 'khor tshogs la// sor 'brangs bka' stsal sdig can dmag bshams kyang*// 'tshe bar ma bzod mang po skyabs su song*// lag na rdo rje sprul pa'i khro bo yis// ri rab rtse mo'i khang brtsegs gzungs bsgrags so// dga' bo nyer dga'i zam pas rgya mtshor gshegs// skye rgyud gsungs pas klu yi sdug bsngal bsal// sems dpa' zla snying sa snying nam mkha'i snying*// dpal gyi lha mos zhus pa'i mdo rnams stsal// btang bzung ri las rdzu 'phrul mnyan yod gshegs// u dra yā na rab byung dgra bcom tshe// blon pos dbyen byas gtsug phud can gyis bsad// mchog zung ngan song brgyus pa'i gtam las brtsams// sgo khang 'khor ba'i 'khor lo bris shig stsal// de mthong 'phral la mtho bas bden pa mthong*// bā ra dhwa dza rab byung bsod snyoms bsten// dpal skyes maung gal bu las rab byung bcug

/bcu gnyis mig dang srid par 'pho ba dang*// ye shes phyag rgya la sogs mang du gsungs// lus 'phags ma dang gser mchog byang chub bstan// rgyal byed tshal du za ma tog bkod gsungs// gang tshe spyan ras gzigs kyis dmyal ba dang*// yi dwags don mdzad de la ston pas bsngags// nag pa rab byung khyim bdag phan par gdams// sbrang rtsi'i gnas pa rab byung dgra bcom nas// chom rkun mang po dad pas rab tu byung*// tshong pa nya mid kyis skrag sangs rgyas bos// de thos kha zums shi 'phos chos srid gyur// rab byung snga ma'i lus mthong zag pa zad// ma dros klu yis zhus pa'i mdo gsungs nas// rgya mtshor spyan drangs bshos gsol dam chos stsal// byang chub lung bstan sa srungs khur gyis byon// rgyal byed tshal du 'dul ba gtan dbab stsal// n+ya gro dhar ni phreng can gser 'od sogs// shākya'i bu rnams rab byung kun dga' bor// kha la me 'bar skyob pa'i rig sngags dang*// bram zer dri med gzungs kyis tshe srog bsrings// shā ri'i bu la chos kyi phung po dang*// bde byed zhus pa sogs gsungs legs skar la// gcer bu shi nas yi dwags skye 'gyur bstan// 'jig rten 'dzin dang bu mo rnam dag gis// zhus pa'i mdo gsungs de dag byang chub bstan// siṅga la ru sangs rgyas sgra thos pas// mu tig can mas ston par zhu yig phul// lan du bris sku 'phrin yig bcas bsring ba// mthong bas bden mthong mu tig skyes su phul// 'jam dpal lho phyogs skyid pa'i 'byung gnas bzhugs// shā ri'i bu sogs drug cu byang chub bkod// nor bzung byang chub sems spyod 'dris pa'i tshe// bshes gnyen 'tshol gsungs sprin gyi dpal drung song*// mchog zung gzhi lnga sgrogs pa'i khrod byon nas// lhas byin gnyid kyis ra ro mchog zung dag /nam mkhar 'phags nas 'od 'byin chos bstan pas// 'khor tshogs lhas byin spangs nas rjes su 'brangs// ston pas chos bstan dge 'dun dbyen 'dums mdzad// glang po'i rtsal dang sgrib pa dag mdo gsungs// thub dbang rim gro byed pa kun dga' bo// yon tan khyad par brgyad dang ldan pas bskos// tshul khrims 'chal ba tshar gcod mdo sde gsungs// 'od srungs brnyas pa spang phyir stan phyed bstabs// dge rtsa yongs 'dzin dpa' bar 'gro ba dang*// zung mdo blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa// mkha' mdzod sogs gsungs sdig can nor gyi phyir// sems bskyed pa yang byang chub lung bstan stsal// dpal sbas byas pa 'gyod cing bsnyen par rdzogs// blo gros rgya mtsho rin chen zhus sogs stsal// bud med 'gyur ba byang chub 'gyur lung bstan// gdol mo rab byung dpal bzang zhus pa bstan// garga'i rdzing 'gram 'chi med rnga sgra gsungs// sgra gcan gyis zin zla bas ston par bskyabs// myur du thongs shig bka' stsal 'phral la btang*// phug ron khras bdas sku yi grib mar bskyabs// lag brgyud gnas su mtshan mo rtswa gdan bzhugs// chos bstan phyir mi 'ong thob de yis kyang*// gtsug lag khang brtsigs ston pa 'khor bcas phul// shi 'phos lhar skyes ston pa'i drung du lhags// bkod rgyan yid bzhin nor bu gza' yum gsungs// bā ra dhwa dza bsod snyoms len pas kyang*// 'gro mang dgra bcom shar pa dad par bkod// ston pas rgyal po'i khab tu seng ge'i rtsal// chos kun 'byung med 'char byed zhus pa gsungs// zla bar nor rgyun ma gsungs sngo bsangs sogs// bsregs pa'i ro bstan mi rtag gtam yang mdzad// rgyal po shar par las kyi rgyu ba bstan// ri bo ta lar sangs rgyas zhing bkod stsal// spyan ras gzigs kyis phyag stong spyan stong gzungs// don zhags cho ga zhib mo ston par gsol// sā la'i nags khrod theg chen 'jug sgo gsungs// lag na rdo rjes phyag rdor dbang bskur bshad// rab snang tshal du byang sems spyod yul gsungs// bden smra dang bgros byang chub lung du bstan// chos dbyer sangs rgyas snying po dad stobs bskyed// bsam mi khyab 'jug 'jam dbyangs sgrib sel bgros// bya rgod spungs par dkon brtsegs sdom gsum bstan// spyan ras gzigs kyis kun bzang gzungs gsol to// sgra sgrogs gnas su sbrang rtsi can rab byung*// ston mchog 'khor bcas sbrang rtsi'i bsnyen bkur byas// bde gshegs bdun gyi smon lam khyad sogs gsungs// dri med grags pa na ba'i tshul bstan tshe// sems dpa' dgra bcom tshogs rnams nad 'drir btang*// de yis bstan pa bgro brtsams ston pa'i drung*// gshegs sogs ngo mtshar bkod pa bgrang yas bstan// khye'u rin chen byin mchongs me tog phul// 'jam dpal dang bgros gdams ngag dgongs pas smras// dge slong brgyad dag tshe 'phos dmyal bar lhung*// skad cig dga' ldan skyes 'phral spyan sngar lhags// khye'u'i mdo dang lhag bsam bskul mdo stsal// sher phyin gsungs tshe mi gsod tshogs gdul phyir// bcom ldan zhabs la seng ldeng tshal pas zug

/de rgyu bstan pas skrag cing sdig bshags nas// gsad bya gsod byed mang pos bden mthong bkod// brag dang nye brag rab byung bshul lam du// seng ge'i 'jigs dogs khye'us bsel bgyis pas// rang rgyal lung bstan seng ge rngams lhags pa// me dang seng ge spru btul lhar skye mdzad// dkon mchog ta la glog thob zhus pa gsungs// sangs rgyas bsten par 'os pa'i sman gyi tshad// lhas byin gyis bzas ma zhu gsud de mnar// rdzu 'phrul phyag ring brkyangs te bsos kyang khros// maung gal bu yis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor brtol// gro bzhin skyes las zas blangs ston par phul// gro bzhin chos bstan bden mthong rab tu byung*// drang srong ke na ya dang ri bo'i phyir// rdzing bu dal 'bab 'gram du chos bstan nas// rgyal chen rnam zhi bstan pa'i srung mar bsgos// 'od srungs kun dga' bor bcas bstan pa gtad// de tshe chos thos bden mthong ke na yas// bshos bstabs de gnyis 'khor bcas rab tu byung*// lhas byin sgyogs kyi 'khrul 'khor 'phangs pa'i rdo// phyag na rdo rjes phye mar brlag pa'i dum// kumbi ras bzung shi ba lhar skyes mdzad// zegs mas zhabs la phog pa'i sku mtshal bab// 'tsho byed sman gyis btab kyang ma chad pa// 'od srungs bden pa brjod 'phral sku mtshal chad// lhas byin nor skyong glang po'i tshogs rbad par// ston pa'i phyag las seng ge lnga sprul te// khor yug me yis bskor bas gzhan dag 'gyel// nor skyong skrag ste skyabs bsten rjes su 'brangs// dbang po'i brag phug yang dag 'jog tshul gyis// sangs rgyas 'jug srid zhing du rgyal rnams bgros// brag phug lcags mchu mi rgod rnam sbyong gsungs// brgya byin gzugs sprul mchod sbyin 'dun khang gshegs// de dag dga' bar gyur nas rang gzungs kyis// chos bstan bram ze drug khri bden mthong bzhag

/sangs rgyas dge 'dun bsod snyoms mi stob pa// ma skyes dgra dang lhas byin khrims bcas tshe// brgya byin lha yi zas phul chos nyan pa// de mthong rgyal po cung zad dad par gyur// rgyal byed tshal du bde gshegs bgro sogs gsungs// rgyal po gsal rgyal rin chen gos mchog bstabs// lta bas yo byad kyis bstabs byang chub tu// lung bstan bran bu skyong gnyis rab byung stsal// su ma na yi sgong skyes bu bcu yang*// rab byung gang tshe bde chen zhing bkod gsungs// bu ram shing 'phel ma ga dhā bzang mos// ring nas spyan 'dren spos gtul bum chus sbreng*// sang nyin kauṇḍi 'od srungs mchog zung dang*// ma 'gags byams gang nye 'khor ka tyā'i bu// gsus che pi linda bu gro bzhin skyes// sgra gcan 'dzin rnams rdzu 'phrul mthus byon rjes// bcom ldan byang sems 'dod gzugs lhas bskor ba// gshegs te 'gro ba grangs med byang chub bkod// gser gyi glang po lhan skyes gser bai'u// ma skyes dgras gtses rab byung zag zad gyur// ston pa'i bkas gnang glang po sa la byings// lag na rdo rjes rdo rje sa 'og bshad// lus 'phags btsun mos bskul ltar ma skyes dgras// sangs rgyas spyan 'dren zhus nas bkur stis mchod// rgud pa kun bcom byams pa lung yang bstan// gzhon nu'i gsos kyis spyan drangs tshal bzhugs tshe// ma skyes dgra yis 'gyod bshags dad par bzhag /mkhas pa'i snyems pas ma grol gzhon nu'i gos// chos gos grwar bzung gangs can ri la khrid// sna tshogs sman gyi spang gnyen ma shes par// ston pas legs gsungs dad pas bden pa mthong*// kun mkhyen ba gam phyir zla bas sgyu ma'i khyams// bkod pa phun tshogs sprul tshe brgya byin dang*// rgyal chen bzhis kyang rnam par rgyal 'dra bskrun// de mthong ngo mtshar sgyu ma brtul 'dod kyang*// ston pa der gshegs sgyu ma brtul ma shes// sgyu ma'i zas kyang brims pa gnang ltar brims// byang chub lung bstan theg chen rab tu byung*// gang tshe rab zhi ting nge 'dzin mdo gsungs// dbul po gter rnyed chad pa las grol ba'i// khyo shug dag dang gaṅgā rab tu byung*// 'od ma'i tshal du gang pos zhus pa dang*// dbyug pa can du bden bzhi'i chos gsungs so// gaṅgār klu yi gdengs ka'i zam par gshegs// rgyal po sma chen mchod sdong gzigs nas 'dis// ma pham yid 'byung 'tshang rgya 'gyur lung bstan// ston pa spyan 'dren phyir lhags ne tso ni// 'ol bas bsad pa lhar skyes bden pa mthong*// a mra skyong dang li tsha bī gnas su// mi pham pas bstod byang chub lung bstan stsal// yangs pa'i grong 'jug gsungs nas kun dga' bor// yangs pa can sgor bsgrags dang thub mchog gis// byon te stong 'joms gsungs pas yams nad zhi// shes ldan gyis mchod byang chub lung du bstan// bram ze'i grong du bsod snyoms phyir gshegs kyang*// lhung bzed stong log lha mang bden pa mthong*// khron pa can du khye'u shi ba'i ma// bden pa mthong mdzod sngon rabs byung ba gsungs// nag po'i grong gi gnod sbyin bslab gzhir bzhag

/sog ma med pa rdzu 'phrul mes btul nas// bka' bzhin bsgrub pa khas blangs bslab gzhir bzhag /kha cher nyi ma gung pa lung bstan cing*// gnyid 'grogs sogs su gnod sbyin srin po btul// rdza mkhan gzugs kyis rdza mkhan bden mthong mdzad// mdung can gnod sbyin mo btul 'bra go yi// byis pa ka niṣka ru 'gyur lung bstan// khyim bdag rin chen 'khor bcas rab tu byung*// shākya mda' thogs 'chi bar lung bstan nas// dmyal ba bstan pas bden mthong lhar skyer mdzad// bcom brlag gshegs nas gar mkhan dpa' bo'i khang*// ma 'ongs 'byung dang nyer sbas lung bstan stsal// bram ze rdo gyur chos thos bsngags pa phul// bong bus nyer mtshon gnod sbyin nyis stong lhag /btul nas rang rang kun dga' rwa ba brtsigs// zhing pa lnga brgya chos bstan bden pa mthong*// bran mo ka tsaṅga las sangs rgyas mthong*// rang gi bur mthong 'khyud pa dgra bcom bzhag /dgra mthar mes sbyin gnas bzhugs sdig blon gyis// ngan bslabs bsod snyoms ma phul ded dpon gyis// cang shes kyis mtshon rta yi chas phyir bstabs// bu mo'i tshogs kyis gtsang byas dbyar gnas mthar// de kun 'khor los sgyur sogs smon lam btab// mes byin gdugs tshod spyan drangs chos bstan gshegs// gnag rdzi dga' bo rab byung gang gi tshe// sbal pa tshe 'phos lhar skyes chos nyan lhags// me lce 'bar ba'i yi dwags tshogs kyi kha// phye nas chu yis tshim byas lhar skye mdzad// gnas bcas kun rar dkon mchog 'byung mdo gsungs// bram ze zhing rmod thug pa sangs rgyas phul// khron pa'i chur blugs 'phel ba kun la brims// de yi zhing la gser gyi snye mas gtams// bcom ldan 'khor bcas zla gsum bsnyen bkur byas// sangs rgyas 'od srungs ring bsrel phyung nas bstan// gsal rgyal gyis mchod mar me'i phreng bsgrigs kyang*// bkres mo dga' byed mar me chung ngu yis// de kun zil mnan byang chub lung yang bstan// bram ze kun rgyu'i bu mo zung dag gis// sangs rgyas skur pa btab mtshang brgya byin brtol// legs 'ongs utpal brims mthar rab tu byung*// khyim bdag chung ma sbrum pa bu 'byung bar// rgyal bas lung bstan ston pa drug dag gis// dug gis bsad pa dur khrod bor ba'i sar// ston pas der gshegs me la bsreg bcug tshe// khye'u lto ba nas byung 'tsho byed blangs// bu mo mya ngan med byin spobs pa yis// nyan thos tshogs bcom ston pa'i spyan sngar phyin// bden tshig brjod pas skyes par gyur pa dang*// btsun mo zla can gser mchog 'od dpal gsum// 'jigs byin bcas pa byang chub lung du bstan// bu mo zla mchog slong ba'i tshogs 'dus tshe// lag pa'i padmar sangs rgyas bzhugs bstan nas// nam mkhar 'phags te ston pa'i spyan sngar song*// sku de ston pa la thim padma yis// gtor ba khang brtsegs gyur par der bzhugs nas// byang chub lung bstan skyes pa'i dngos por gyur// byis pa gsod rir gnod sbyin 'jigs byed btul// byams zhus mdo gsungs a mra chu ngogs klu// legs 'ongs kyis btul bsnams pa bslab gzhir bzhag

/khyim bdag khyo shug bslab bya lnga mdo stsal// sna tshogs grong du rdo rje snying po gsungs// brgya byin sprul pa'i khang bzangs bsnyen bkur tshe// khang bzangs brtul te mi rtag gtam yang mdzad// spos ngad can gshegs blo gros mtha' yas pa'i// rgyal po'i khang bzangs bzhugs tshe bzang skyong la// nam mkha' mdzod kyis 'dul ba bzod mdo bshad// spyan sngar 'dus pa'i nyan rang mu stegs can// grangs med tshogs la chos bstan lam gsum bkod// rgyal byed tshal du rgya che rol mdo gsungs// rgyal khab 'od dpag med bkod gsungs pa'i tshe// gang ba'i lhung bzed phul ba sa 'og btang*// gzhan gyis ma rnyed 'jam dpal phyag gi 'od// padma rgyal skus mtshan pa ring brkyangs te// 'od zer rgyal po'i zhing nas legs phyung bas// dman sems gzhol ba'i lha rnams sems mchog bskyed// ma skyes dgra yi mdze nad phol mig sogs// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis sel bar bka' stsal 'phral// ri rab rtse mor gshegs bzhugs phyag rdor gyis// rnam 'joms rgyal chen bzhir bshad khrus su bcug /ri bo ta lar seng ge'i sgra gzungs stsal// sang nyin 'jam dpal 'od srungs bcas der gshegs// rgyal po'i nad dang 'gyod pa yongs bsal te// chos bstan mthun pa'i chos la bzod pa thob// de nyid zla ba'i dpal bcas byang chub bstan// skyed ma bsad pa'i sdig can rab byung mdzad// seng ges gser gyi gdugs phul byang chub tu// lung bstan rab byung de yis zhus pa gsungs// dri med byin la de yis zhus pa stsal// bden pa'i tshig gis pho lus bsgyur de dang*// tshangs pa'i tshe yang byang chub 'gyur bar bstan// rnga bo che yi mdo stsal 'thab med du// dpal gyi phreng mas gsol btab ngor gshegs te// byang chub lung bstan de yis zhus pa gsungs// lhas byin bzod gsol tshul gyis ston pa'i zhabs// dug gi sen mos btab kyang ma phigs brul// mnar med me 'bar gson par tshig pa na// sangs rgyas skyabs gsol 'bras bu rang rgyal bstan// bde byed mchod rten phyag bskor na bza' phul// bgrang yas rgyal ba'i gsang ba ring bsrel gsungs// zhabs rjes padma sems dpas mtshan byung bas// mchod cing tshong dpon sdig bcom byang chub bstan// 'am ci sdong pos pi wang sgra yis gtam// zab mo 'byin lhags de yis zhus pa gsungs// spos ngan can du spyan drangs rang gi bu// brgyad stong sems bskyed ston pa nam mkha'i dbyings// bzhugs nas sdong po byang chub lung du bstan// gangs can yul du padma drwa ba'i rgyud// sangs rgyas bdun pa blo gros rab gnas gsungs// bskal pa bzang po rin chen drwa ba can// drang srong rgyas pas zhus pa'i mdo rnams gsungs// drang song skar ma la dgas bcom ldan 'das// mthong bas dad la chos bstan mchog lung stsal// nor bu rgyas pa ting 'dzin rgyal po gsungs// klu chen rgya mtshos zhus gsungs rgya mtsho'i klong*// spyan drangs der byon chos bstan de nyid dang*// sgra gcan 'dzin dang rgya mtsho'i bu mo dag

/byang chub lung bstan mkha' lding 'jigs las bskyabs// bya rgod spungs par dam chos padma dkar// nyan thos dge slong mang po byang chub bstan// nam mkhar mchod rten byung bar rgyal kun gyis// bskul ltar ston pa'i phyag gis sgo phye tshe// de na rin chen mang bzhugs des kyang bsngags// chos bcu pa dang ting 'dzin sprin chen mdo// gser 'od gsang ba bsam mi khyab pa'i mdo// kun tu bzang pos bzang spyod smon lam bshad// wā rā ṇa sī'i a mra'i nags tshal du// sangs rgyas stobs bskyed cho 'phrul mdo stsal to// lcang lo can du bde mchog ral gcig ma// gos sngon can dang gar mkhan mchog gzungs stsal// gtsang gnas 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rtogs pa dang*// stug po'i zhing khams rgyan stug bkod pa gsungs// rgyal byed tshal du rnam par mi rtog gzungs// byams pa 'jug mdo mi ldog 'khor lo stsal// ser skyar byams pa lung bstan skye dgu yi// bdag mo la sogs lnga brgya mya ngan las// 'das pa'i gdung gi khyogs bteg bsregs sbyangs stsal// gang tshe nyes med 'char ka bkrongs pa'i lus// phyag dar phung por sbas bsal sbyang du stsal// shākya mang po bden pa mthong bar bkod// 'od ma'i tshal du rmi lam bstan pa dang*// rnam par 'thags pa thams cad bsdus pa gsungs// rgan skyes rab byung chos bstan dgra bcom bkod// shākya pho mo mang bsad 'phags skyes po// ma la gnod bcas rgyal bas lung bstan ltar// me yis tshig nas mnar med dmyal bar lhung*// kun dga'i sring mo'i bu gnyis kun dga' bos// rab byung dgra bcom nam mkhar me tog 'thu// ma dros mtshor gshegs dga' bo nye dga' yis// padma 'dab stong sprul pa'i snying por bzhugs// 'dab mar dgra bcom tshogs 'khod shā ri'i bu// bya rgod phung por gnas pa maung gal bu// 'bod du btang ba rdzu 'phrul 'gran gyin byung*// ston pa nyan thos lnga brgya rang rang gis// las rgyu lung bstan me tog brtsegs gzungs stsal// grong khyer thigs pa can pas spyan drangs tshe// yi dwags kha 'bar lnga brgya bcas gshegs nas// de dag nye dur ngo sprad yon bsngo mdzad// smra 'dod seng ges sad phyir bu ram snod// lnga brgya phul yang gcig gis kun tshim mdzad// 'dod pa chung shes dad pas rab tu byung*// yangs pa can pas ston par mi mched khrims// bcas pa ma thos khyim bdag nor can zhes// bu smad kun gyis bsnyen bkur bden mthong gyur// sha ba'i tshal du dbyar gnas snyun pa bcil// srin bu padma'i nags khrod gyad rnams kyis// mched byas ku sha'i grong gyi gyad lnga brgyas// gshegs shul pha bong bsal ba ma nus pa// rde'u bzhin tshangs gnas bor ba phyag mthil lhung*// dbugs kyis phye mar btags gtor gcig tu bsdoms// rdo 'phangs gzungs stsal gyad rnams bden par bkod// bya rgod phung rir sprin chen mdo mjug brtul// li yul glang ru lung bstan rnam sras dang*// kun rgyal la gtad dri med 'od sogs kyis// yul der bstan pa 'dzin pa smon pa dang*// dri med 'od kyis zhus pa'i mdo gsungs nas// mchod rten go ma sa la ganda gshegs// glang ru'i steng bzhugs mtsho nang padma'i grangs// gtsug lag khang 'byung dam chos dar bar gsungs// yangs can mchod rten drung bzhugs kun dga' bor// bskul bar bzhugs 'os gsungs kyang gsol ma btab// bdud kyis mya ngan 'da' gsol zhal 'chos dang*// tsundas gsol btab zla gsum bzhugs par gnang*// dri med gzi ngor kun bsdus ting 'dzin gsungs// de dang a mra skyong mas sems mchog bskyed// bya rgod phung por drin lan bsab mdo stsal// sku las 'od zer bkye bas dmyal ba'i gnas// snang byas lhas byin lus reg bde bar mdzad// thar pa phyogs su rgyas pa gsung ba'i tshe// dge mthong 'gyod tshangs bgyis pas sdig dral gyur// sangs rgyas nyi ma mya ngan 'das phyogs pas// sngon du mchog zung dgra bcom brgyad khri dang*// bdun brgya dang bcas myang 'das dbyings su gshegs// khye'u khye'u'i steng langs sa snying gang*// phul ba chos rgyal mya ngan med lung bstan// 'od srungs kun dgar bstan pa'i bslab bya stsal// lho phyogs 'bras spungs mchod rten cher gshegs te// zla bzang la sogs 'khor tshogs grangs med dbus// dang po'i sangs rgyas 'dus pa kye rdor sogs// zab rgyas rdo rje theg pa'i chos 'khor bskor// yangs can khams gsum las 'das gzhal med khang*// dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa'i mdo sde gsungs// chu gter cher gshegs klu yi snying po gshegs laṅkar gshegs pa dang*// dri med grags sogs yang phur la sogs gsungs// bshul lam snyung bar kun dgas rnyog chu phul// g.yung pos phul ba'i ras gsol sku mdangs bskyed// rtsā can sā la'i tshal du
